_comment: ORRERY Mail tool parameters this install relies on. agentstack-doctor reads the running Mail's tools/list and reports each one it lacks. Add an entry when the dashboard, a hook or a launcher starts depending on a newer Mail; name the tool and parameter exactly as tools/list advertises them.

features.needed_for: Claude children saved in the old format keep ORRERY Mail on resume and re-spawn
features.without_it: the dashboard resumes them as a conversation only, and spawn_child.sh will not adopt them
